name: Kyle Gwinnup
biography: Kyle is a Senior Threat Researcher in Carbon Black's TAU team. He has over 10 years of experience in many areas of computer science and IT. Prior to Carbon Black, Kyle worked in finance and with the DoD in various roles ranging from network/systems administrator, software engineer, reverse engineer, penetration tester and offensive tool developer. At Carbon Black, Kyle's focus is on large scale program analysis, primarily static but moving asymptotically toward dynamic analysis. Twitter: @switchp0rt
